title: A lipid-related transcriptomic signature for distinguishing Kawasaki disease from febrile infections: a Mendelian randomization and machine-learning study.
summary: MR of 422 exposures plus 459 candidate transcripts; 130 ML combinations, frozen full-training LASSO applied to independent GSE68004. Results: no MR survives correction (minimum BH q=.979); 12-gene panel external AUC .851 (95% CI .768–.934); HUVEC and longitudinal expression are hypothesis-generating.
ai_technology: Machine-learning classifiers prioritize a lipid-related transcriptomic signature and test discrimination in an independent cohort; Mendelian-randomization results did not survive correction.
